title: Container Bookings: Contract Reference, Bunker Billing and Quote Validity by Tier
content:
Within Container Bookings, the six products differ in whether a booking is rated on a spot quote or under a service contract, in how bunker cost reaches the invoice, and in how long a rate stays usable. This page tabulates those settings tier by tier.

## Settings compared

| Booking product | Service contract must be referenced | Service contract may be referenced | Lowest contract tier rank accepted | Bunker cost billed as | Rate usable for (calendar days after issue) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| AHL Spot Saver | no | no | 0 | part of the quoted rate | 7 |
| AHL Spot Flex | no | no | 0 | part of the quoted rate | 14 |
| AHL Contract Booking | yes | yes | 1 | its own bunker adjustment line from the contract schedule | 30 |
| AHL Contract Priority | yes | yes | 4 | its own bunker adjustment line from the contract schedule | 30 |
| AHL Guaranteed Loading | no | yes | 0 | part of the quoted rate | 7 |
| AHL Premium Express | no | yes | 0 | part of the quoted rate | 7 |

A rank of 0 signals that the product needs no contract at all. For the two products that must reference a contract, the contract concerned has to stand in active status.

## Points of judgement

- **Spot-only products.** AHL Spot Saver and AHL Spot Flex neither require nor permit a contract reference, so a booking under either carries no contract.
- **Contract-only products.** Neither AHL Contract Priority nor AHL Contract Booking is available without one; the rank column states the lowest service contract tier that can carry them.
- **Either way.** A booking under AHL Premium Express or AHL Guaranteed Loading can be placed on a spot basis or against a contract.
- **Bunker cost.** Where the column reads "part of the quoted rate", no separate bunker adjustment line is billed; where it names the contract schedule, bunker cost appears as a line of its own.
- **Rate life.** The last column is counted in calendar days from the day the spot quote or filed contract rate was issued.

**Hypothetical illustration.** A spot quote for AHL Spot Flex issued on a given day remains bookable through the fourteenth calendar day after that day; the same quote length for AHL Premium Express would be seven days. The dates are examples only.
